optimizer_loops.finding: Original prompt could visually reveal a monster that was only heard and conflated defeated with dead.
optimizer_loops.change: Require VISIBLE before creature art; require outcome confirmation for DEFEATED; death is separate.
optimizer_loops.evidence: resolver unit tests cover heard-only and confirmed defeat.

optimizer_loops.finding: Existing ScenePlate rendered environment and actor together instead of one primary image.
optimizer_loops.change: ScenePlate now resolves and renders exactly one primary image above narrative text.
optimizer_loops.evidence: single-image component contract and resolver priority.

optimizer_loops.finding: Fallback wording allowed stale or wrong-state images and could encourage unnecessary unique art per round.
optimizer_loops.change: Last image is reusable only when both current state and prior image identify the same node and the image still matches current state; otherwise use current environment or text; ATTACK may be reused across rounds.
optimizer_loops.evidence: policy JSON plus resolver tests for same-node, discovery, time, and state legality.
